| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Window size** `size` | 3 | 3 to 5, odd px | The window of neighbors that predict the center, which itself is left out. |
| **Forgetting factor lambda** `lambda` | 0.999 | 0.95 to 1 | How much each older pixel still counts. Pixel n steps back counts lambda to the power n. |
| **Start regularization delta** `delta` | 0.01 | 0.001 to 10 | P starts as the identity divided by delta. A small delta trusts the first pixels a lot. |
| **Output** `output` | Prediction (denoised) | Prediction (denoised), Prediction error (around mid gray) | The prediction from the neighbors, or the pixel minus its prediction, shown around 128. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect 101 (default) | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | RGB | RGB, Brightness only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
